chapter: Other bands and the Philadelphia years
title: Years in Philadelphia and Henry Lowe's band
summary: Zardis lived in Philadelphia in the mid-1940s after leaving George Morrison's band in Denver, and played with Henry Lowe.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: A lot of those sons died. Yeah, yeah. How long were you in Philadelphia?
I stayed in Philadelphia from 40, 45 I believe. No, I left for...
You were there in 44 I know, because you made those records with George Lewis when I was

The next year I came down and they said you were in Philadelphia. I didn't even have your address. That's why that money I owed you all those years. I didn't even know where you were except they said you were in Philadelphia.

Well I was living in North Philly. I lived on 12th and Girard. See, I even bought a home over there. I bought a nice home over there. And because I was thinking the time when I left Denver, Colorado, that's when I left George Morrison's band, you know, like I told you. Well I came to Philadelphia after that and I started working with Henry Lowe's band. That's the secretary of the local out there. Well I played with his band and played a nice long time.
